paths.title: Fast Custom GPT Setup
paths.goal: Load the Knowledge Layer and Recommended Priority Pack first, then validate answers against compliance-aware examples.
paths.nextStep: Upload priority knowledge docs, run compliance eval cases, then add action schemas after review.

paths.title: No-Auth Action Launch
paths.goal: Ship public/stateless GPT Actions for education, planning, copy review, templates, scripts, and readiness checks.
paths.nextStep: Install no-auth schemas in a test GPT, run copy-review cases, and keep human review on any sensitive output.

paths.title: API-Key Backend Build
paths.goal: Create private backend Actions for CRM, pipeline, intake, secure uploads, communications, compliance logging, and workflow automation.
paths.nextStep: Stand up the backend boundary first, lock secrets outside the client, and validate confirmation rules before any send/write workflows.

paths.title: Schema + Deployment Hardening
paths.goal: Harden OpenAPI, JSON Schema, YAML schemas, validation reports, shared models, security review, and deployment checks.
paths.nextStep: Validate schema dependencies, run test cases, then package only reviewed artifacts for Vercel deployment.
